title: Proration of Wear Forgiveness on Early and Late Kestrel Advantage Balloon Returns
content:
**Return option terms — timing of the return and wear forgiveness.** On a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, the wear forgiveness is prorated according to when the vehicle came back:

| Vehicle came back | Wear forgiveness |
|---|---|
| Before the maturity date | Multiplied by the calendar days from the contract date to the return date over the calendar days from the contract date to the maturity date, and rounded to the cent |
| After the maturity date, on a contract with installments deferred by extension (installments deferred over the life of the contract above zero) | Multiplied by the sum of the term in months and the installments deferred over the term in months, and rounded to the cent |
| On the maturity date, or after it with no installment ever deferred | Not prorated |

The proration acts on the wear forgiveness as it stands for the contract, and the result is rounded to the cent at this point. Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one.

## Hypothetical cases (wear forgiveness USD 400.00)

- **Back early.** 700 days held of 730 in the term: 400.00 times 700 over 730 is 383.5616..., rounded to USD 383.56.
- **Back late, 1 installment deferred on a 36-month term.** 400.00 times 37 over 36 is 411.111..., rounded to USD 411.11.
- **Back late, nothing deferred.** USD 400.00.
- **Back on the maturity date.** USD 400.00.
